Sam (Support): FYI customer acme-inc can't apply promo code FREE30 during signup. UI shows \"Payment method required\" even though promo is configured to waive card. They tried twice, 3DS launched then timed out. Stripe req id req_0xABC123. Can payments take a look?

Alex H: Which customer/email? Can you paste the signup payload + promo code? Also is this on hosted or private?

Sam (Support): Hosted. Customer email: ops@acme-inc.com. Signup payload:
```json
{ \"email\": \"ops@acme-inc.com\", \"promo\": \"FREE30\", \"plan\": \"starter\" }
```
Stripe PI response (redacted):
```json
{\"id\":\"pi_1JxABCDEF\",\"status\":\"requires_action\",\"next_action\":{\"type\":\"use_stripe_sdk\"},\"last_payment_error\":null}
```
Webhook sequence shows `payment_intent.requires_action` then `payment_intent.canceled` with reason `authentication_timeout`. req id: req_0xABC123

Maria P (Payments): Looking now. I can see the webhook chain for pi_1JxABCDEF. The promo redemption path is hitting a validation that expects `customer.default_payment_method` after the recent checkout change (deploy-765 on 2026-02-14). That makes the flow require a card for promos that should be cardless.

Jordan R (Billing): Yep — that validation was intended for enterprise promos but the selector logic was too broad. It effectively flipped `require_card_for_promo` on for all promos where a PaymentIntent is created. I'll roll back the check in canary unless someone objects.

Alex H: Can we grant the trial credits manually for this customer ASAP? Sam, confirm the customer is blocked in prod.

Sam (Support): Confirmed blocked, onboarding stalled, customer needs access today. Please grant 30 credits and note in ticket SUP-998. :pray:

Jordan R (Billing): I'll start rollback in canary. In parallel, Payments can grant manual credit via admin API: 
```http
POST /admin/customers/grant_credit
{
  \"customer_id\": \"cus_abc123\",
  \"amount_cents\": 3000,
  \"reason\": \"promo FREE30 manual grant\"
}
```
Set metadata `granted_by=payments`.

Maria P (Payments): Done — granted $30 credit (admin_tx_202631). Added note for finance and linked to SUP-998. Also added a temporary feature-flag to skip the new validation for non-billing promos.

Sam (Support): Customer retried signup after we granted credit and can now complete onboarding. They reported no 3DS this time. I'll update the customer that we applied a manual credit and are fixing the bug.

Alex H: Good. Action items: Jordan to open PR reverting the broad validation + add unit/integration tests; Payments to add automated e2e for promo-without-card flows; Support to confirm affected accounts and notify. Tagging postmortem. :memo:

BillingBot: Reminder created BILL-421 (billing backlog) and linked SUP-998. Release-rollback-765 flagged.

Sam (Support): Closing this thread — will add logs and timeline to SUP-998 and the postmortem doc. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
